high: The adapter/loop is not provider-agnostic as required: the loop hardcodes codex_imagegen and the adapter implements generation only for codex_imagegen; reuse, CSS, SVG, composition, and human_boundary cannot be selected through the same loop without code changes.

Vision QA is not mechanically fail-closed against its stated threshold. It trusts the critic-supplied PASS verdict without independently rejecting missing/non-numeric scores or applicable scores below 70.
Manifest v2 marks char-haru qa_passed despite missing QA scores and records only a manually restored race note; this does not provide the required per-asset QA provenance.
The need-reduction artifact contradicts its own semantic finding: it says bg-road cannot communicate the ESSENTIAL shop scene, then resolves that need by reusing bg-road.
medium: The lock uses a non-atomic exists-then-write sequence, so simultaneous processes can both acquire it and clobber manifest entries; the artifact confirms this race already occurred.
Link QA labels oversized and duplicate-content assets as warnings and exits successfully, contradicting its fail-closed claim for oversized additions.
Missing-link detection only validates explicit asset paths containing extensions; broken extensionless helper references are not detected.
Provider success is inferred solely from the existence of the requested filename; the Codex process exit status, reply JSON, image format, and file integrity are not validated before copying.
Existing legacy assets are assigned subscription_included_confirmed despite provider unknown_legacy, making cost provenance unsupported.
low: The generated before/after pair is visually highly consistent and correctly shows only the middle shutter opening, although the after scene lacks the requested plain noren curtain.
char-haru is correctly wired and visually usable, but its output is full-body despite the request specifying upper-body composition.
Dynamic-prefix detection is global rather than scoped to the helper/path context, so unrelated assets sharing a prefix can be falsely protected from orphan classification.

recommended_actions: Introduce a provider-neutral request/result interface and route reuse, css, svg, composition, codex_imagegen, and human_boundary through it; remove the hardcoded provider from art-loop.
Validate every required QA score in code, require finite 0-100 values, compute the verdict mechanically, and fail on missing categories or any applicable score below 70.
Rerun char-haru QA and replace the restored manifest entry with complete structured scores, issues, mechanical checks, prompt, hash, and run provenance.
Make lock creation atomic using exclusive file creation and avoid unconditional removal of a lock not owned by the current PID.
Require semantic confirmation before reuse; regenerate art-needs so the acknowledged-unrelated bg-road asset cannot resolve the essential shop scene.
Make link QA fail for newly oversized/duplicate additions and extend reference checking to recognized extensionless helper calls and dynamic paths.
Require successful provider exit, parse and validate the reply contract, verify image format/dimensions, and constrain all input/output paths to approved repository directories.
Use unknown cost status for unknown legacy provenance unless subscription inclusion is actually evidenced.
